title: Spec 016 primary production runtime profile
description: The logical TaxAi:Production configuration profile validated by TaxAI.AzureInfrastructure.ProductionConfigurationValidator, keyed by the colon-form configuration names below the TaxAi:Production section. This is the primary Canada Central profile only; T01 approves no other profile. A recovery profile (Canada East application recovery with Canada Central-only Document Intelligence) is introduced by T06 and is not accepted here. The closed key set is identical to infra/azure/contracts/runtime-configuration.schema.json without the TaxAi__Production__ prefix and without the evidence manifest; any other key is an unapproved configuration entry and refuses admission.

Environment.description: Exact host environment; there is no enable switch.

PrimaryRegion.description: Primary region for all normal-operation resources (FR-01).

TenantId.description: Entra tenant of the managed identity.

ResourceGroup.description: Resource group holding the approved inventory.

ArtifactVersion.description: Exact artifact version; must equal the running build's informational version.

DocumentIntelligence:Endpoint.description: Document Intelligence custom-subdomain resource-specific endpoint; must be the named resource's own host.

DocumentIntelligence:ResourceId.description: Document Intelligence custom-subdomain resource id in the configured subscription and resource group.

DocumentIntelligence:PublicNetworkAccess.description: Public network access must be disabled (FR-05).

DocumentIntelligence:PrivateEndpoint.description: Private endpoint and private DNS are required (FR-05).

SourceStorage:Endpoint.description: Source content storage account resource-specific endpoint; must be the named resource's own host.

SourceStorage:ResourceId.description: Source content storage account resource id in the configured subscription and resource group.

SourceStorage:PublicNetworkAccess.description: Public network access must be disabled (FR-05).

SourceStorage:PrivateEndpoint.description: Private endpoint and private DNS are required (FR-05).

KeyVault:Endpoint.description: Key Vault resource-specific endpoint; must be the named resource's own host.

KeyVault:ResourceId.description: Key Vault resource id in the configured subscription and resource group.

KeyVault:PublicNetworkAccess.description: Public network access must be disabled (FR-05).

KeyVault:PrivateEndpoint.description: Private endpoint and private DNS are required (FR-05).

Sql:Endpoint.description: Azure SQL logical server resource-specific endpoint; must be the named resource's own host.

Sql:ResourceId.description: Azure SQL logical server resource id in the configured subscription and resource group.

Sql:PublicNetworkAccess.description: Public network access must be disabled (FR-05).

Sql:PrivateEndpoint.description: Private endpoint and private DNS are required (FR-05).

SourceEnvelope:KeyUri.description: Versionless Key Vault key wrapping per-content source keys; in the configured vault.

DataProtection:StorageEndpoint.description: Control storage account for the key ring; must differ from source storage.

DataProtection:KeyUri.description: Versionless Key Vault key wrapping the key ring; distinct from the source envelope key.

DataProtection:ApplicationDiscriminator.description: Discriminator shared only by intended production instances.

Resilience:OperationDeadline.description: [ASSUMED] finite operation deadline, greater than zero and at most 00:10:00.

Resilience:ProbeDeadline.description: [ASSUMED] finite identity-probe deadline, greater than zero and at most 00:01:00.

Recovery:Profile.description: Spec 016 T06: the deployment profile. The IaC emits the primary Canada Central profile only; the manual CanadaEastRecovery profile is a separately signed configuration validated by ProductionConfigurationValidator (docs/operations/canadian-recovery.md).

Recovery:ControlLedger:Endpoint.description: Spec 016 T06: the recovery control ledger's Canada Central copy; the account's own Blob endpoint, distinct from every other storage account.

Recovery:ControlLedger:ResourceId.description: Spec 016 T06: the resource id of the control ledger's Canada Central copy in the configured subscription and resource group.

Recovery:ControlLedger:Region.description: Spec 016 T06: the control ledger's Canada Central copy region.

Recovery:ControlLedger:PublicNetworkAcce.description: Public network access must be disabled (FR-05).

Recovery:ControlLedger:PrivateEndpoint.description: Private endpoint and private DNS are required (FR-05).

Recovery:ControlLedgerReplica:Endpoint.description: Spec 016 T06: the recovery control ledger's authoritative, independently recoverable Canada East copy; the account's own Blob endpoint, distinct from every other storage account.

Recovery:ControlLedgerReplica:ResourceId.description: Spec 016 T06: the resource id of the control ledger's authoritative, independently recoverable Canada East copy in the configured subscription and resource group.

Recovery:ControlLedgerReplica:Region.description: Spec 016 T06: the control ledger's authoritative, independently recoverable Canada East copy region.

Recovery:ControlLedgerReplica:PublicNetw.description: Public network access must be disabled (FR-05).

Recovery:ControlLedgerReplica:PrivateEnd.description: Private endpoint and private DNS are required (FR-05).

Recovery:SqlPointInTimeRestoreDays.description: Spec 016 T06 (FR-11, AC-111): SQL short-term point-in-time retention, the 35-day maximum.

Recovery:BackupChainDays.description: Spec 016 T06 (AC-103): the documented weekly full-backup chain kept beyond the retention period.

Recovery:ControlLedgerRetentionDays.description: Spec 016 T06 (FR-10, AC-103): [ASSUMED] control ledger immutability; strictly longer than 35 + 7 days.
